reason: Inspected verification analyses directly compare prompting and inference-effort variants with substantial model dependence.

candidates.title: Choose error-localization prompts per verifier
candidates.rule: When asking a math verifier to find the first error, compare direct error-index prompting with deriving the index from step-level judgments for each verifier model.
candidates.passage: we advise practitioners to determine the better prompting setup on a per-verifier basis.
candidates.finding: Step-level prompting improves Gemini 2.5 Pro balanced F1 from 52.46 to 62.78 but reduces Seed-OSS-36B from 45.18 to 33.55. More detailed verification is not uniformly beneficial.
workloads: Hard2Verify frontier open-ended math step verification
candidates.conditions: Human-annotated error labels; first-error index can be produced directly or derived from all step labels.
candidates.limitations: Benchmark-specific and model-specific effects; not evidence that direct prompting always suits small models. Error identification does not establish that an agent can repair the proof.
candidates.validation_test: Compare both prompts on held-out human-labeled proofs; report balanced F1, missed errors, false alarms and token cost by verifier and proof difficulty.

candidates.title: Compare reasoning effort with parallel verifier votes
candidates.rule: For frontier-math step verification, compare higher sequential reasoning effort with majority voting over low-effort samples before spending the budget on parallel judges.
candidates.passage: Best-of- N does not meaningfully improve over sampling 1 response as N increases.
candidates.finding: gpt-oss-20B balanced F1 rises from 59.69 to 70.93 at higher effort, while bootstrapped low-effort votes do not close the gap. gpt-oss-120B also improves with effort. The method called best-of-N aggregates labels by majority vote.
candidates.conditions: Parallel experiment samples thirty-two low-effort outputs and bootstraps N=4–16 with replacement over ten repetitions.
candidates.limitations: Exact token or monetary budget matching is not established. Bootstrapping cached samples is not independent repeated deployment. Results concern verification rather than general problem solving.
candidates.validation_test: Compare effort settings and independent low-effort ensembles under measured token and latency budgets; assess balanced F1 and false acceptance on fresh proofs.

review_scope: Selected abstract, introduction, methods or main-result sections; not a comprehensive paper or appendix review.
